title: Northbeam TechWorks Rate Card Annex: Crew Attendance and Distance
content:
Bringing a crew to an address is charged separately from the work carried out on it. This annex to the Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair rate card carries, service by service, the charge for bringing a crew to the address, the labour and parts total at or above which that charge is waived, the miles from the service point covered without a mileage charge, and the charge for each mile beyond the covered radius.

| TechWorks service | Crew attendance charge, USD | Labour and parts total at or above which it is waived, USD | Covered radius, miles | Each mile beyond, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 49.00 | 299.00 | 30 | 2.25 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 69.00 | 499.00 | 45 | 2.75 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 59.00 | 399.00 | 35 | 2.50 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 89.00 | 750.00 | 60 | 3.00 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 0.00 | 0.00 | 75 | 2.00 |

## Notes on the annex

**A bench job carries no attendance figures.** Work handled at the store counter is brought to the retailer rather than the other way about: its crew attendance charge, its waiver figure, its covered radius and its per-mile charge all stand at nothing.

**The annual care service carries a radius without an attendance charge.** TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual covers 75 miles from the service point, further than any other TechWorks service, and charges 2.00 USD for each mile beyond that; its crew attendance charge and the total at which such a charge would be waived both stand at 0.00.

**The waiver figure rises with the attendance charge.** Where an attendance charge is carried at all, the total of labour and parts at or above which it is waived rises with it: 299.00 USD against a 49.00 USD charge, 399.00 USD against 59.00 USD, 499.00 USD against 69.00 USD and 750.00 USD against 89.00 USD.
